parallel.requirements: The parallel attempt recognized the task as a clean-room reimplementation of SoX v14.4.2 from the binary and bundled documentation only, with no source-code lookup, wrapping, or disassembly.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent split observation work across children for info mode, effects, and help surface while retaining implementation, assembly, verification, and final delivery ownership.
parallel.implementation: The parent produced sox_clean.py, compile.sh, captured help fixtures, rebuilt executable, and created play, rec, and soxi entrypoints with support for the probed CLI, file I/O, combine, and effect subset.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Integration was centralized in the parent: child findings were used as observations, then a single parent-authored implementation and build script were packaged into the artifact.
parallel.verification: The parent ran representative smoke tests for version/help, soxi behavior, generated audio, raw and pipe I/O, synth, trim, channels, volume, gain, rate, stat, stats, and combine modes.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The final response acknowledged residual risk on the broad legacy SoX format and effect surface, and the current official evaluator failed the solution at 313 of 1260 passed tests.

serial.requirements: The serial attempt recognized the same clean-room SoX v14.4.2 task and the same constraints against source-code lookup, wrapper solutions, and binary disassembly.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single agent performed all probing, implementation, integration, cleanup, and final delivery without delegation or child-agent handoffs.
serial.implementation: The serial solution created src/sox.py and compile.sh with a broader single-file Python implementation covering observed sox and info CLI, WAV, AIFF, AU, raw, combines, reverse, and several effects.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial implementation was directly built into ./executable by compile.sh, with no cross-agent reconciliation or competing workspace ownership.
serial.verification: The serial agent recompiled from the cleaned workspace and smoke-tested help, no-arg failure, info, raw-to-WAV, trim, reverse, mix/merge, and stat/stats, including some byte-level comparisons during development.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial final response also acknowledged incomplete long-tail SoX fidelity, but its official evaluator result was higher at 399 of 1260 passed tests.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the clean-room SoX replacement task and the prohibition on source lookup, wrapping, and binary analysis.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same prompt and constraints, giving a matched task-difficulty control.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition difference is visible; the later score gap comes from implementation coverage, not a different prompt understanding.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel delegated observational probing to three child agents while the parent kept final implementation and packaging ownership.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child activity and used one continuous local owner for probing, implementation, and delivery.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The concrete difference is delegation for research only in parallel; it did not leave implementation, integration, assembly, or the end-to-end pipeline ownerless.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child work was returned as observational reports on info mode, effects, and help behavior, and the parent consumed those reports while implementing.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial obtained comparable facts by local probes and applied them directly in a single implementation thread.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There is no visible missing brief, lost handoff, stale result, or incompatible cross-agent contract; the parallel handoff boundary was informational and completed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote sox_clean.py plus compile.sh and used fixtures for observed help text, focusing on a representative subset of formats and effects.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote src/sox.py plus compile.sh with broader direct code coverage for formats such as AIFF/AU/raw and effects including reverse, rate, speed, stat, and stats.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial covered more ordinary implementation surface, which plausibly explains the higher failed score without requiring a coordination-specific failure label.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent retrieved child results before finalization and then proceeded with its own implementation and checks.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child lifecycle to join and completed its local implementation path directly.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No parallel child implementation or verifier result was trapped, ignored, cancelled, or joined after verification; the lifecycle difference was ordinary use of probe reports.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel final artifact contained one parent-authored executable path, compile script, fixtures, and play/rec/soxi links; child work was not competing final source.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial final artifact contained src/sox.py, compile.sh, executable, documentation, and no child-owned competing implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There is no observed concurrent write collision, overwrite, or contaminated shared artifact; final-tree differences reflect each agent design, not shared-state failure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran representative checks across version/help, soxi, generated audio, and some effects but closed with explicit residual risk on the full SoX surface.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran a cleaned-workspace smoke test and earlier byte-level comparisons on help/info and selected processing behavior, with residual risk on the long tail.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial verification accompanied broader coverage, while parallel verification was narrower; neither run had full evaluator-equivalent coverage before closure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel spent more agent time and tokens due to child probing but still finished normally, packaged an artifact, and reported residual coverage limits.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial finished normally with lower elapsed agent time and no delegation overhead while still delivering a partial implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The budget difference is measurable but not a realized concurrency failure: no child wait or fan-out episode visibly displaced a required final stage.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both current completed official evaluations failed, so there is no discordant pass/fail outcome to attribute to parallel coordination. Parallel scored 313/1260 and serial scored 399/1260; the concrete difference is that serial implemented broader ordinary behavior while parallel used child probes but left a narrower SoX subset. The parallel children returned useful observations, and the parent owned implementation, integration, testing, cleanup, and delivery, so the observed gap does not clear the taxonomy retention gate.
parallel_contributors: Parallel implemented a probed subset around help, info, WAV/raw/SoX pipe, synth, trim, channels, volume/gain/rate, stat/stats, combine modes, and play/rec/soxi behavior.
Parallel acknowledged that the implementation was strongest only on the probed subset and not the entire SoX 14.4.2 legacy surface.
serial_contributors: Serial implemented a broader single-file Python SoX path including AIFF, AU, raw, WAV, reverse, mix/merge, rate, speed, stat, stats, and command parsing.
Serial verified from a cleaned workspace and reported byte-level matches for some simpler cases, resulting in a higher but still failing official score.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial had broader ordinary feature coverage; parallel did not show a lost child result, missing join, write collision, or child failure that explains the score gap.
Both attempts remained partial reimplementations of a very large SoX surface and both failed official evaluation.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; supported comparative explanation for score gap only
